items.title: [FEATURE] Feed Wikelo trade data into the holo dossier buy tab
items.description: Approved in the batch concept (B2.5/B2.9): the Kaufen tab should show Wikelo trades with the required parts and how many the user already holds. The UI is built (codex-holo-buy-tab, wikeloNeeds input, stock count from HqInventoryService), but the Codex holds no Wikelo trade data, so codex-detail.component.ts never binds wikeloNeeds and the row only appears for records whose name contains 'wikelo'. Needs a data source for Wikelo trades (extractor or curated table).

items.title: [BUG] Stop search specs from writing to the cloud database
items.description: Found while investigating the 1292 'gladius' search misses: codex-search-engine.spec.ts ran with the real Supabase client and wrote search_log_miss to the cloud project on every test run (fixed in this batch). codex-search-bar.component.spec.ts and shell/quick-search.component.spec.ts still run without a fake Supabase client and can write search_log_open (popularity ranking) to the cloud database. Provide fakeSupabase in both and add a guard that fails a spec when it reaches the real client.
